entities.name: Library Management System
entities.description: Provides cataloging, circulation management, and self-service portals for public and academic libraries while enforcing strict EU-only data residency and high-performance search capabilities.

entities.name: Library Member (Patron)
entities.description: End-user who accesses self-service portals for searching catalogs and managing loans.

entities.name: Librarian / Staff
entities.description: Library personnel who manage circulation, cataloging, and day-to-day operations.

entities.name: Library Administrator
entities.description: System administrator responsible for managing the library management system configuration and settings.

entities.name: Payment Gateway
entities.description: External system used for processing fine settlements.

entities.name: Notification Provider
entities.description: External system used for sending out loan reminders and alerts.

entities.name: Identity Provider
entities.description: External system used for user authentication and identity management.

interfaces.description: Interacts with the system via self-service portals

naming_conventions: Users and roles use descriptive titles with role descriptors in parentheses where applicable
External systems are named after their functional domain capabilities
